summary: Elizabeth Linskill (1833–1916), great-granddaughter of Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux and wife of Merrit Sickler; John's 2nd cousin 5 times removed.
bio: Elizabeth Linskill was born on 10 October 1833, the daughter of John Linskill and Mary Steele of Lehman Township and a great-granddaughter of Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux and Keturah Tuttle. On 18 March 1871 she married Merrit Sickler of Huntsville. She died on 22 January 1916.

birth.place: Lehman Township, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, USA

sources: DAR Genealogical Records Committee lineage sheet, Thomas Lamoreaux line via Charity Lamoreaux and Peter Steele Jr.: Keturah Tuttle 'living 4/16/1816', married 1770; headstone erected by a local chapter of the Daughters of 1812; FamilySearch image group 008978866, image 616: https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QHK-93R2-ZDG7 (transcript supplied by John, 15 Nov 2026)
